purpose: Teach: 率いる/解っ/おこなっ/御座い/ことごとく/いたす/こんなにも/みつけ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チームを率いる役職に就かれたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard you've taken on a team lead position with the customers.
lines.style: Warm observation, speaking to Aoi with gentle pride. Soft pace, thoughtful — like turning something over in her mind. Voice settles on each word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の好みが解ってきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You've really started to understand what the regulars like, haven't you?
lines.style: Bright, affirming tone with a smile in the voice. Direct eye contact through the words. Light warmth, genuinely pleased for her friend.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店で新メニュー試食会をおこなってみたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'd love to see you host a menu tasting here at the café.
lines.style: Gentle enthusiasm, almost dreaming it aloud. Unhurried, speaking from genuine excitement rather than urgency. Leans forward slightly in tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様には「ありがとう御座います」を丁寧に申しましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You should make sure to say thank you to the customers with real care, okay?
lines.style: Light directiveness, more guide than instruction. Warm, not bossy. The tone of someone offering a small piece of wisdom to someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご要望をことごとく覚えておきたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to remember every single thing our customers ask for.
lines.style: Determined but soft. A quiet commitment spoken almost to herself. Pace steady and intentional, building gently toward the resolve.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、「お願いいたす」と仰るお客様、増えたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: More and more customers are asking so politely for things now.
lines.style: Noticing tone, slightly surprised and pleased. The voice of someone who sees a small, good change happening. Warm, reflective, not judgmental.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、こんなにも素敵なお客様が増えて幸せね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm happy so many wonderful customers are coming in.
lines.style: Tender and genuine, the words landing softly. Unhurried, sincere — not performing happiness but feeling it. Slight warmth on 'wonderful', gentle fadeout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、棚の奥に新しい器をみつけたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I found some beautiful new dishes on the back shelf the other day.
lines.style: Pleased discovery-voice, gentle brightness. The tone of sharing something small and nice. Unhurried, intimate — speaking to someone she trusts. Slight lift at the end.
